title: The Tortoise Elder
text: A tortoise as big as a cart, its shell grown over with moss and ferns and little trees, crosses the path one step a minute. It is older than the Pact. Its ancient eye turns to you, slow and knowing.

options.label: Wait for the old tortoise to cross.

outcomes.text: Hours. It looks at each of you as it passes, and nods, and you feel seen by something very old.

options.label: The boldest climbs onto its shell.

outcomes.text: It carries them, and the party walks alongside, the slow sure way, and its patience gets into them.
It shrugs them off, slowly, and the fall is not slow at all.
Round it is a long way too, and its slowness gets into you.
